messages:
Mara: Quick pulse  need a tight benchmark narrative for the launch post + a fast 30min webinar. Focus: latency vs unit cost, and clear routing for inbound leads.
Alex: Hero visual = scatter (median latency ms on x, $/1k on y), colored by deployment. Secondary = waterfall showing batching/cache savings at scale.
Sam: I'll export CSV with fields: deployment_mode, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_request, batching_savings_pct. Also a small violin for tail variance. ETA EOD.
Priya: Headline candidate: "Make inference economics visible." Subhead: "Predictable latency, transparent unit costs across hosted, dedicated, and private." CTA: "Run your workload	get a tailored latency & cost report in 48h."
Noah: Routing rules: if Expected_RPS >= 50 OR Compliance includes SOC2/PCI/HIPAA -> Enterprise queue. Else -> Growth. Tag leads with Benchmark_Interest (latency|cost|batching). SFDC fields: Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Benchmark_Interest__c, Demo_Priority__c.
Jen: Webinar plan: 30m total. 8m claims + 7m demo (scatter + waterfall), 10m tech deep-dive (violin + batching examples), 5m Q&A. Invite list: PMs, Infra, Platform SEs.
Mara: Methodology note: tokens counted = prompt + completion. Dedicated numbers assume reserved pools and baseline autoscale off. No vendor names.
Sam: CSV placeholder: https://internal.storage/redwood/bench_exports/2854207777.csv
Priya: I'll draft landing copy and three outreach blurbs today. Will include hidden form fields: Demo_Priority (auto set when RPS>=50) and Benchmark_Variant.
Noah: I'll confirm Zapier -> SFDC mapping and post the automation snippet here.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for 2026-10-12 16:00 UTC. Please confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Action items: Sam export + assets, Priya landing copy, Jen outreach, Noah SFDC mapping. Check back here with status updates. :thumbsup:
